message.content: {"question": "20. In a study of the chemistry of glass etching, an inorganic chemist examines the reaction between sand (SiO2) and hydrogen fluoride at a temperature above the boiling point of water: SiO2(s) + 4HF(g) ↔ SiF4(g) + 2H2O(g) Predict in which direction will the reaction proceed and the effect on [SiF4] when some liquid water is added ;", "options": {"A": "to the right and [SiF4] increases", "B": "to the right and [SiF4] decreases", "C": "to the left and [SiF4] increases", "D": "to the left and [SiF4] decreases", "E": "None of these choices is correct"}, "correct": "D"}
